NoAds.Description: Suggested apps, tips and 'finish setting up' prompts in Start, Settings, the lock screen and File Explorer.

NoWebSearch.Description: WinUtil's BingSearch toggle plus the policy that recent Windows 11 versions honor.

Debloat.Description: For every user. They can be installed again from the Microsoft Store.

DeleteTempFiles.Description: WinUtil's DeleteTempFiles, but keeping Setup's own folder, which holds these scripts.
InvokeScript: Get-ChildItem -Path $Env:Temp, "$Env:SystemRoot\Temp" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object Name -ne (Split-Path $SetupFolder -Leaf) | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

DisableMPO.Description: The 'Disabled (Compatibility)' choice of WinUtil's Multiplane Overlay setting.

UltimatePerformance.Description: What WinUtil's button does, with a fixed GUID for the copy so running it again does not add another one.

RemoveOneDrive.Description: WinUtil's RemoveOneDrive, but retrying the leftover files that stay in use a few seconds after the uninstaller instead of stopping the rest.
